identity_and_theme.tagline: The Intelligence Layer for Irish Property Buyers
identity_and_theme.theme_archetype: Official Public Registry Ledger x Modern High-Trust Fintech
identity_and_theme.language: British English (colour, organise, prioritise, licence, programme)
identity_and_theme.tone: Trustworthy, authoritative, direct, data-driven, restrained, zero sales hype

rules.contrast: Text must maintain at least 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio. White text on dark green #0f5132 is allowed. Dark ink #1A231E on parchment #FBF9F5 achieves 14:1 contrast.
rules.gradient_limit: NO full-screen gradient blankets. Gradients allowed ONLY for subtle spotlight radial effects and border hairline glow.

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-lg or rounded-xl (max 12px) to match official government ledger feel. No hyper-rounded bubble corners.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetric bento grid with high-density data cards, hairline borders (1px solid #E2DDD3), and official document serial tag styling.

sections_breakdown.name: The Problem Section
sections_breakdown.design_pattern: Numbered Manifesto Chapters with High Contrast Ledger Cards

items.title: Asking Price ≠ Actual Sale Value
items.description: Property listings display asking prices set by sellers and agents. What you actually need to know is what similar houses on that exact street sold for in the official government registry.

items.title: Hidden Time on Market
items.description: Adverts are frequently relisted to reset perceived freshness. Properties sitting for 300+ days often look like fresh uploads to unsuspecting buyers.

items.title: Manual Cross-Referencing Friction
items.description: Checking the government Property Price Register requires switching tabs, searching mismatched address formats, and filtering through dozens of irrelevant entries by hand.

questions.q: Where does the historical property price data come from?
questions.a: All historical sale data is sourced directly from the official Property Price Register (PPR), maintained by the Irish Property Services Regulatory Authority (PSR).

questions.q: Does Eire Finder work on sites other than Daft.ie and MyHome.ie?
questions.a: Currently, Eire Finder specifically targets Daft.ie and MyHome.ie as they cover over 95% of Irish residential listings. Support for additional portals is on our public roadmap.

questions.q: Is Eire Finder affiliated with Daft, MyHome, or the Irish Government?
questions.a: No. Eire Finder is an entirely independent research tool created by property buyers for property buyers. We have no commercial relationship with listing portals or state bodies.

questions.q: How does Eire Finder match listing addresses to government records?
questions.a: Our automated matching engine parses property titles, townlands, postal districts, and street names to match adverts against official PPR records in under 400 milliseconds.

motion_and_interactions.engine: CSS Animations + Vanilla JS IntersectionObserver + Mouse-Tracking Spotlight via CSS Custom Properties + Lenis Smooth Scroll (via CDN)

effects.name: IntersectionObserver Fade-Up Reveal
effects.css: opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

effects.name: Rubber Stamp Effect
effects.css: transform: scale(3) rotate(-12deg); opacity: 0; animation: stampDown 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) forwards;

effects.name: Mouse Spotlight Grid
effects.js: document.querySelectorAll('.spotlight-card').forEach(card => card.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect(); card.style.setProperty('--mouse-x', `${e.clientX - rect.left}px`); card.style.setProperty('--mouse-y', `${e.clientY - rect.top}px`); }))

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete application directly into the project structure with zero placeholders.
Follow British English spelling strictly throughout all copy (colour, organise, prioritise, centre, licence).
Ensure plain CSS/JS compatibility directives are clear for any vanilla or React implementation.
Include all required data-testid attributes on every interactive element.
Make the floating panel mockup interactive with working tabs or toggle states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard blue SaaS gradients.
Dark clover green (#0f5132) must be used as a solid high-trust anchor, paired with archival parchment tones (#FBF9F5).
Never use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk for headings.
Add generous padding (p-8 to p-12) to all bordered cards to prevent text collision.
Use data-testid on every interactive element.
